snippet.title: Sackboy Moveset (SSBU Modding Direct 3.14.2026)
snippet.description:
This is a work in progress of a moveset mod for Super Smash Bros. Ultimate that will bring Sackboy from Little Big Planet to the roster!. Thanks to everyone who helped me!

The WIP for the moveset can be found here: 
https://gamebanana.com/wips/98793

Super Smash Bros. Ultimate Modding Direct 3.14.2026:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rJlw5v9vJk8&t=3298s
